medium: hand-drawn stick figures and green country-map characters with eyes on plain white, hand-drawn money bags, banknotes and bank buildings, pasted screenshots of charts and articles; comic hand-lettered captions
avoid: 3D render, shading, gradients, photographs of people, coloured backgrounds, text baked into the image
note: No presenter. Words in his frames are hand-lettered comic captions; the overlay supplies ours. Memes and copyrighted characters (Up, SpongeBob, Baldi) are never generated; title cards are drawn by the renderer.

looks.label: Stick figures and drawn objects on white
looks.when: the default - anyone doing anything: a figure at a chalkboard, at a podium, holding cash, next to a bank or a pile of money.
looks.prompt: A quick black-marker drawing on plain white: stick figures with round peach-coloured faces and dot eyes, simple flat-coloured objects beside them - a green money bag, a banknote, a beige bank building with columns, a green chalkboard - thin uneven lines, no shading, most of the page left empty. No words.

looks.label: Country map with a face
looks.when: a country or the whole world as the actor - Japan, the US, Europe, the globe - drawn as a map shape with eyes and stick arms.
looks.prompt: A quick marker drawing on plain white: the outline of a country filled flat green, given two big cartoon eyes and thin stick arms and legs, sometimes holding a banknote or a piece of paper, sometimes worried or smug; no shading, no other background. No words.

looks.label: Pasted screenshot with a stick figure
looks.when: a source - a chart, a headline, a tweet, an official statement - pasted on the page, often with a stick figure pointing at it.
looks.prompt: On plain white, a rectangular screenshot pasted flat - a line chart with a small source logo, or a news page with a headline as grey illegible lines and a red circle around one detail - and beside it a stick figure with a round peach face pointing at it with a stick. No readable words.

looks.label: Hand-lettered title card
looks.when: a chapter break or a beat of dread - words on a coloured card. Drawn by the renderer, never generated.

looks.label: Meme or borrowed character
looks.when: a reaction meme or a character from a film or game - real footage only, never generated.
